attributes.name: Totem Klar
attributes.powers:
If you played a card that has the 2-Handed trait on this check, you may not play this card. 

Recharge this card to add 1d6 and the Piercing trait to your combat check. If proficient with light armors and you fail this check, reduce all damage dealt to you by 3.

Recharge this card to examine the top card of your location deck.
